# Supply Brain — Data Dictionary (v3)

*Field-level reference for every table in `input datasets/`. Generated by `supply_brain_generator_v3.py`. For table-level grain, entity relationships, and narrative context see `DATASET_DOCUMENTATION.md`; for realized figures on this data instance see `EDA_REPORT.md`.*

**Conventions**
- All monetary fields are USD, suffixed `_usd`.
- `period` is an ISO-style week label `YYYY-Www` (e.g. `2025-W01`); `week_start_date` is the Monday of that week.
- Rate/percentage fields (`*_pct`, `*_pct_annual`) are fractions (e.g. `0.22` = 22%), not 0–100 integers.
- PK = primary key, FK = foreign key.

---

## sku_master
**Grain:** one row per SKU · 500 rows

| Field | Type | Key | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sku_id` | string | PK | Unique SKU identifier (e.g. `SKU0001`) |
| `sku_code` | string | | Category-prefixed product code (e.g. `BEV-0001`) |
| `category` | string | | One of 5 top-level categories: Beverages, Snacks & Confectionery, Dairy & Bakery, Frozen Foods, Grocery |
| `subcategory` | string | | Product subcategory (e.g. Liquor, Dry Wine, Tea), mapped to a real product group for price/elasticity grounding |
| `brand` | string | | Synthetic brand label |
| `list_price_usd` | float | | Shelf/list price per unit, USD |
| `unit_cost_usd` | float | | Cost to produce/acquire one unit, USD |
| `margin_usd` | float | | `list_price_usd − unit_cost_usd` |
| `margin_pct` | float | | Margin as a fraction of list price |
| `holding_cost_per_unit_year_usd` | float | | Annual carrying cost per unit, USD |
| `shelf_life_days` | int | | Perishability window in days (5–21d for Dairy & Bakery, up to 540d for Grocery/Frozen) |
| `segment` | string | | Demand segment: `Fast-Moving` (50%), `Seasonal` (30%), `Intermediate` (20%) |
| `price_tier` | string | | `Premium` or `Value` |
| `seasonal_flag` | bool | | `TRUE` for SKUs with a pronounced seasonal demand pattern (150 of 500) |

## plant_master
**Grain:** one row per production plant · 4 rows

| Field | Type | Key | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plant_id` | string | PK | Unique plant identifier (e.g. `PLANT01`) |
| `plant_name` | string | | Display name (e.g. "Atlanta Production Center") |
| `city` | string | | US city |
| `state` | string | | US state abbreviation |
| `production_capacity_units_per_week` | int | | Weekly production capacity constraint |
| `no_inventory_flag` | bool | | Always `TRUE` — plants are production-only and hold no stock |

## plant_dc_master
**Grain:** one row per plant DC · 4 rows (one per plant)

| Field | Type | Key | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plant_dc_id` | string | PK | Unique plant DC identifier (e.g. `PDC01`) |
| `plant_id` | string | FK → `plant_master.plant_id` | Parent plant |
| `city` | string | | US city, typically co-located with the parent plant |
| `state` | string | | US state abbreviation |
| `storage_capacity_units` | int | | Warehouse capacity constraint. First stock-holding echelon in the network |

## orders
**Grain:** one row per order line (SKU × DC × Customer × Day) · 260,770 rows · 52 weeks, 2025

| Field | Type | Key | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | string | | Basket identifier — one per customer × DC × order date; multiple SKU lines share an `order_id` |
| `order_date` | date | | Date the order was placed |
| `delivery_date` | date | | `order_date` + fulfilment lead (DSD 1–3 days, BULK 2–6 days) |
| `period` | string | | ISO week label for weekly roll-ups |
| `sku_id` | string | FK → `sku_master.sku_id` | Product ordered |
| `dc_id` | string | FK → regional/customer DC id | Stocking DC fulfilling the order |
| `b2b_customer_id` | string | FK → `b2b_customer_master.b2b_customer_id` | Ordering banner |
| `order_qty` | int | | Units ordered on this line |
| `base_price_usd` | float | | Everyday shelf price at time of order (drifts with inflation, steps at 1–3 revisions/yr) |
| `unit_price_usd` | float | | Actual price charged after any discount |
| `list_price_usd` | float | | SKU's catalog list price (from `sku_master`) |
| `discount_pct` | float | | Discount applied, if any (0 if none; 5–35% when on promo) |
| `on_promo` | bool | | Whether this line was discounted under a trade promotion |
| `promo_id` | string | FK → `promotions.promo_id` | The promo event that set the discount, if `on_promo` |
| `revenue_usd` | float | | `order_qty × unit_price_usd` |

---

## promotions
**Grain:** one row per promo event · 1,741 rows

| Field | Type | Key | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `promo_id` | string | PK | Unique promo identifier |
| `sku_id` | string | FK → `sku_master.sku_id` | Promoted SKU |
| `b2b_customer_id` | string | FK → `b2b_customer_master.b2b_customer_id`, or `ALL` | Banner the promo applies to (customer-specific; trade promotions are negotiated per account), or `ALL` for a blanket promo |
| `start_date` | date | | Promo start date |
| `end_date` | date | | Promo end date |
| `discount_pct` | float | | Discount depth for the event (5–35%) |
| `promo_type` | string | | e.g. `Display`, `Feature`, `Feature+Display` |

*This table is the single source of the discounts seen in `orders` — every promoted order line carries the `promo_id` of the event that set its discount.*

## demand_forecast
**Grain:** one row per SKU × DC × Customer × Week · 659,506 rows · 104 weeks (2025–2026)

| Field | Type | Key | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `period` | string | | ISO week label |
| `week_start_date` | date | | Monday of that week |
| `horizon` | string | | `in_sample` (2025, has actuals) or `forward` (2026, forecast only — the MEIO execution horizon) |
| `sku_id` | string | FK → `sku_master.sku_id` | Product forecasted |
| `dc_id` | string | FK → regional/customer DC id | Stocking DC |
| `b2b_customer_id` | string | FK → `b2b_customer_master.b2b_customer_id` | Banner |
| `forecast_qty` | int | | Forecasted demand in units |
| `actual_qty` | float | | Realized demand — populated only when `horizon = in_sample`; blank for `forward` |
| `forecast_error_pct` | float | | `(forecast − actual) / actual` — populated only when `horizon = in_sample` |

## inventory
**Grain:** one row per SKU × DC × Week · 295,256 rows · 52 weeks, 2025

| Field | Type | Key | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `period` | string | | ISO week label |
| `week_start_date` | date | | Monday of that week |
| `sku_id` | string | FK → `sku_master.sku_id` | Product |
| `dc_id` | string | FK → regional/customer DC id | Stocking DC |

| `receipts` | int | | Units received into this DC during the week |
| `shipments` | int | | Units shipped out to fulfil demand during the week |
| `closing_stock` | int | | `opening_stock + receipts − shipments` |
| `safety_stock` | int | | Simulated safety stock buffer for this SKU-DC-week |
| `reorder_point` | int | | Simulated reorder trigger level |

## Not shipped — deliberately absent

| What | Why | How to get it |
|---|---|---|
| Price elasticity (base and promotional) | Would defeat the point of estimation practice on a "client-like" extract | Estimate via a two-way (SKU + week) fixed-effects regression on `orders` — method and code snippet documented in `DATASET_DOCUMENTATION.md` |
| Feedback / recalibration-loop data (actual-vs-forecast drift over time, parameter-adjustment history) | Open gap, not yet built into any table | Flagged in `Docs/MEIO in FnB.md` and `Strategy-In-Progress/03-usage-in-project.md` as an unresolved dependency |
